ms.report:
I want to make a few upfront clarifications. We actually went far beyond the original scope of the milestone as its goal was only to produce a design and specs. We actually implemented and not only prototyped most of the specs which are presented below:

 * A fully working backend edge node which allows hopping of payments between between Cardano Lightning and Bitcoin Lightning network: https://github.com/cardano-lightning/konduit

 * A still not released PWA (progressive web app) which allows users to interact with that backend edge node and perform payments:

 * Code: https://github.com/cardano-lightning/konduit-js

 * Deployment: https://app.konduit.channel/

 * Webpage: https://konduit.channel/

Given that extended scope we decided to create a bunch of new repositories but all of them reside under `cardano-lightning` organization. Some of the artifacts which we deliver as a part of this milestone are spread across those other repositories.

A.
 Output: Component mapping diagram
 Acceptance criteria: A spec document in the form of a website.
 Evidence: https://github.com/cardano-lightning/cardano-lightning/blob/main/docs/design/l2-spec/components/gateway.svg

B.
 Output: An explanation of each component, what id does, for whom and how it relates to the other components.
 Acceptance criteria: A spec document in the form of a website.
 Evidence: https://github.com/cardano-lightning/cardano-lightning/blob/main/docs/design/l2-spec/components/gateway.md

 * Distinction between core and auxiliary aspects of spec.
